user_reported_bug: On the different AI Tools page, there is this section (see attached screenshot) telling users to start their 7 day free trial. It shouldnt be showing on pages where users are already authenticated/logged in/already on a free trial or paid plan. That section should only show when users are not logged in the frontend. also create a bit of space between it and the footer, they are too close
summary: Fixed. Focused UI/auth regression testing confirmed the ToolExplainer free-trial CTA is absent for logged-in cathy@example.com on 3 AI Tools pages, remains visible for anonymous visitors on 2 pages, and the explainer has pb-20/80px bottom padding with visible footer spacing. Loaded ai-testing-core; AI generation was not in scope for this UI-only bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Reviewed /app/frontend/src/components/ToolExplainer.jsx: CTA is gated by {!user && (...)} and the explainer container includes pb-20.

Reviewed /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx and /app/frontend/src/App.js: authenticated AI Tools routes wait for auth loading before rendering, so the anonymous CTA did not appear after login/route navigation in runtime tests.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing caregiver test account cathy@example.com / testpass123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Evidence: anonymous invoice-checker and statement-decoder showed exact CTA sections and Start Your 7-Day Free Trial text; authenticated cathy@example.com had [data-testid^='tool-cta-'] count 0 on invoice-checker, statement-decoder, and care-plan-reviewer. All checked explainers had class 'space-y-16 mt-16 pb-20' and computed padding-bottom 80px with >=80px last-content-to-footer gap.
rca_of_the_issue: Original symptom was an unconditional ToolExplainer CTA on AI Tools pages. The fix gates the CTA on AuthContext user being absent and adds pb-20 to the explainer container. Runtime tests against the preview URL verified both behaviours.
